content.title: Reject a zero transfer amount
content.intent: Prove that a non-positive boundary amount is not silently accepted as a successful transfer.
content.technique_notes: Applied boundary value analysis at the documented positivity boundary and negative/error technique because the PRD states invalid monetary values must not be silently accepted and transfer amounts must comply with positivity constraints. Risk-gated interaction strength was 3 because money and data-loss apply, degraded in practice to a single boundary input because only the amount boundary is under test here.
